tips.b: Spend all starting gold on Parsnip seeds (50g). They grow in 4 days and net ~35g profit each — the fastest early XP and income.
Spring 13, Town Square: buy Strawberry Seeds for 100g each. Regrows every 4 days — Spring's best crop. Buy as many as you can afford!
Get 5 Copper Bars + 2,000g to Clint for the upgrade. It waters 3 tiles in one swing — cuts your daily energy cost in half.
Craft after harvesting 8 crops. Without one, crows can destroy your entire field overnight.
Cauliflowers can merge into a Giant Crop (3×3) giving 15–21 items. Worth planting a few alongside your main crops.
Plant all Mixed Seeds you find — you'll get a random seasonal crop for free.
Floor 40 = Iron Ore (for tool upgrades). Floor 80 = Gold Ore (best mid-game tools). Make this your Spring Y1 priority alongside farming.
Fried Eggs (cook at home), Bread from Gus (120g), or Salmonberries from foraging. Pass out at midnight and you lose items and gold.
Copper/Iron bars sell for 2–3× more than raw ore. Keep first batches for tool upgrades, sell the rest as bars not ore.
99 Stone = 1 Staircase. Craft 5–10 to skip floors when time is short. Speed-running the mine beats fighting monsters in Y1.
Send your FIRST of each mineral/gem to Gunther. He rewards you — sometimes with useful furniture or artifacts.
Don't sell Bat Wings! You'll need 99 for Lightning Rods (mid-game must-have). Same for Bug Meat (25 for Bug Steak later).
Willy gives you a free Bamboo Rod on Day 2. Fishing beats farming income in early Spring — Catfish sell for 200g each on rainy days.
Save 1,800g for Willy's Fiberglass Rod. Lets you use Bait (30% faster bites). Biggest early fishing upgrade.
River: Catfish (rainy). Ocean pier: Tuna, Sardine, Eel. Mountain Lake: Bullhead, Carp. Secret Woods pond: Woodskip (anytime).
Craft Crab Pots (3 Iron Bars + 3 Wood each) for passive daily income. Check and rebait every morning.
Community Center needs specific fish for bundles. Keep your first Catfish, Largemouth Bass, Pufferfish etc. in a chest.
Daffodils, Leeks, Dandelions — all free money. Walk every path each morning before other activities. They vanish at season end!
Pick every single Salmonberry bush in town. 30 energy + 13 health each — the best mining fuel you'll have all spring.
Nautilus Shells, Coral, Sea Urchins spawn daily. A 2-minute beach stop adds hundreds of gold per week.
You'll need 300–1,000+ Wood for buildings and fences. Start cutting trees early.
Oak Seeds, Maple Seeds, Pine Cones → plant on farm borders. Future Tappers on these = daily passive income.
Plant Blueberries on Day 1 of Summer. They produce 3 berries each harvest, regrow every 4 days. The single best Summer crop.
Kegs: 2–3× crop value (fruit → wine is amazing). Preserve Jars: 2× for most crops. A shed of 33 Kegs is your primary income engine.
Cranberries = best Fall regrow crop (3 berries, regrows every 5 days). Pumpkins for bundles + Giant Crop chance.
Craft: 1 Iron Bar + 1 Gold Bar + 1 Refined Quartz. Waters 8 tiles in a 3×3 pattern. Eliminates most manual watering.
Coop → Chickens → Eggs → Mayo (190g). Barn → Cows → Milk → Cheese (230g). Upgrade to Deluxe for auto-feeding.
Buy Rare Seeds from Traveling Merchant (Mon/Fri south of farm). Put one in Seed Maker to duplicate → Sweet Gem Berry = 3,000g+ each.
Defeat 3 bosses (Floor 40, 80, 120) to get the Skull Key and unlock Skull Cavern in the desert. Essential for Iridium.
Only enter on HIGH LUCK days (Fortune Teller on TV at 6 AM). Bring: 20+ Bombs, Spicy Eel/Lucky Lunch, 10 Staircases, best sword.
Craft Lightning Rods (99 Bat Wings + 1 Iron Bar + 1 Refined Quartz). Thunderstorms make Battery Packs for Iridium Sprinklers.
Reach 60 artifacts/minerals donated → Gunther gives you the Rusty Key → Sewers → Krobus (Void Eggs, Iridium Band for 500g!).
Fortune Teller channel (TV, 6 AM) shows daily luck. High luck = more ladders, better gem drops, faster Skull Cavern diving.
Buy from Willy for 3,500g. Lets you use Bait AND Tackle simultaneously. The single biggest fishing upgrade.
Spring: Catfish (river, rainy). Summer: Crimsonfish (east ocean pier). Fall: Angler (north bridge). Winter: Glacierfish (south Arrowhead Island pier).
Craft: 1 Copper Bar + 1 Bait. Prevents fish from escaping while you pause reeling. Makes tough fish manageable.
With Mariner profession (Level 10 Fishing), crab pots NEVER produce trash — only seafood. Set 30+ and check daily.
Walleye: Fall, rainy, 12PM–2AM. Eel: Spring/Fall, rainy, 4PM–2AM. Woodskip: Secret Woods pond, any time.
Every Keg needs 1 Oak Resin (from Tapper on Oak Tree, every 7 days). You need 33–100+ Oak Resins for a full Keg setup. Tap everything now.
When Demetrius visits (after first house upgrade), pick Mushroom Cave. Daily mushrooms for cooking/gifting beats random fruit.
Pick every Blackberry bush in town. Restores 20+ energy each. Stock 50–100 for winter mining sessions.
Craft Wild Seeds each season from foraged materials. Harvesting them gives Foraging XP toward Level 10 Botanist.
Pine Tar (5-day cycle) is needed for Cork Bobbers and Bee Houses. Set tappers on every Pine Tree you own.
Ancient Fruit (7-day regrow, year-round in Greenhouse) → Keg = 2,310g base / 3,465g Artisan. Fill Greenhouse with 54 plants + 2 Iridium Sprinklers.
Starfruit (Summer, 2,250g each) → Keg → Artisan Wine = 6,300g per bottle. Highest value single-crop wine in the game.
Complete the Pantry bundles to unlock it. Fill 100% with Ancient Fruit — no seasons, regrows forever. Iridium Sprinklers cover everything.
Craft: 1 Gold Bar + 1 Iridium Bar + 1 Battery Pack. Waters a 5×5 area (24 tiles). Replace every other sprinkler type you have.
After the Community Center, buy Junimo Huts from Wizard (20,000g). Junimos auto-harvest ALL crops in range every morning.
Deluxe Barn of Pigs → Daily Truffles → Truffle Oil = 1,491g Artisan each. 8 pigs = enormous daily income with zero effort.
Max luck day + Lucky Lunch + 30 Bombs + 20 Staircases + Ginger Ale. Floor 100+ = guaranteed Prismatic Shard chance every few floors.
3 Prismatic Shards at 3 pillars in Calico Desert = Galaxy Sword (60 DMG). Combine with 3 Galaxy Souls at Volcano Forge = Infinity Blade (80 DMG)!
Iridium Band (from Dwarf/Krobus, 5,000g) + Lucky Ring (Skull Cavern drop) = best general combo. Or Iridium Band + Napalm Ring for AoE.
All goals at Adventurer's Guild give ring rewards: Slime Charmer, Savage Ring, Burglar's Ring (double monster drops).
Available after Mr. Qi's quest chain. Used for special late crafting recipes and Hyper Speed-Gro. Very rare — don't sell raw.
Mr. Qi's challenge: catch all 5 legendary fish variants in Ginger Island waters. Different season requirements than the originals!
Required for Perfection. Check Collections tab. Some fish are hyper-specific: season + weather + time + location required.
Mr. Qi's Special Orders board has weekly fishing challenges. Complete for Qi Gems → spend in Walnut Room for exclusive items.
Level 10 Angler profession (fish worth 50% more) + Iridium Rod + Cork Bobber = maximum profit per trip. The Legend fish sells for 5,000g+.
Island has unique items: Taro Root, Ginger, Pineapple, Mango. Set up the Island Farm. Some items exist ONLY here — needed for full Perfection.
Upgrade regular Tappers → Heavy Tappers at the Volcano Forge on Ginger Island. Produces sap TWICE as fast.
Botanist (Foraging 10): all foraged items = Iridium quality (max price). Tracker: see forage icons on screen edges. Together = the best setup.
Let trees become Mushroom Trees (random event). Tap them for daily Red/Purple Mushrooms worth 250–280g each.
